controls.name: storyteller_off
controls.what: DebugSettings.enableStoryteller=false, threatScale 0, no big threats, incident queue cleared
controls.hides: storyteller-fired incidents incl. the mod's own IncidentDefs and conditions (seasonal flooding, cinderfall), pacing, threat-point scaling

controls.name: random_events_off
controls.what: random mental states and diseases off
controls.hides: mood-break and disease interactions with the mod

controls.name: wild_spawner_off
controls.hides: the mod's effect on ongoing wildlife arrival; mapgen wildlife is untouched

controls.name: threat_structures_cleared
controls.what: hostile threat structures vanished at setup (vitals classifier: turret, spawner, dormant, condition causer, non-humanlike faction); keep_defs spared
controls.hides: hive/infestation/mech-cluster interactions; insect-faction behaviour on the site

controls.name: hostiles_removed
controls.what: hostile pawns present at setup removed by Vanish (no death action, no corpse)
controls.hides: combat interactions with the mod's things

controls.name: toxic_sources_cleared
controls.what: toxic sources removed at setup and read back: toxic game conditions ended, ToxGas cleared, POLLUTED terrain within TOXIC_SCAN_RADIUS of every colonist repainted to its clean counterpart (Biotech pollution gives ToxicBuildup to a pawn standing on it); the receipt also counts stacked 'Forced weather' controllers
controls.hides: the mod's interaction with pollution, toxic fallout and tox gas near the colonists

controls.name: proximity_letters_sent
controls.what: every CompProximityLetter marked sent (the mapgen void monolith's 'Fallen monolith')
controls.hides: the Anomaly monolith discovery letter and any mod building's proximity letter

controls.name: queue_drain
controls.what: named queued incidents removed at every drain (default StrangerInBlackJoin: the colony-loss rescue is QUEUED by StorytellerComp_Triggered on the death and fires 180 ticks later through IncidentQueueTick, which runs even with the storyteller off)
controls.hides: the end-of-colony rescue; a row ABOUT that rescue must not use this control

controls.name: modal_broker
controls.what: explicit window handlers only (MODAL_HANDLERS); an unknown force-pause window is CAPTURED and blocks the row, never closed blindly; the same window still open after its handler escalates
controls.hides: the handled dialog's other choices (VEF new-faction: 'Do nothing' means the faction is not spawned)

notSuppressed: active quests and their parts (never ended by default: ending a quest changes the world)
scenario parts (ScenPart_CreateIncident ticks outside the storyteller)
existing game conditions, map/world/game components and mod tickers
hives and other pawn-spawning structures, births, egg hatching, breeders
pending drop pods / shuttles / transporters, caravans and world pawns arriving
weather transitions, fires, existing hostile behaviour
quiet_site.note: enableStoryteller is not saved with the game: re-apply after any load
